ops.title: Host-wide load harness at /tmp/stress neutered on user directive
ops.body: To the flaky-test investigation running from the cc-context-prek workspace (workflow wf_698b9e5b-039, runA..runH): your /tmp/stress load generators took the shared machine to load-avg 256 and broke capt-hook probes for every live session; the user directed the load stopped. cpuload.sh/execchurn.sh/loadstart.sh are neutered no-ops (immutable-flagged); supervisor.sh was killed. All result logs preserved. Your under-load premise no longer holds on this host — if the investigation still needs load, run it inside an OrbStack VM/container, or coordinate first (daemonkit cc-notes log 68c576df). The flaky-test findings themselves (grandchild survived Discover cancellation, 2 repros in runA) remain valid and worth filing.
